paragraphs.text: Bread rises because of yeast, a tiny living fungus. When flour and water are mixed with yeast, the yeast feeds on sugars in the flour and releases carbon dioxide gas.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Kneading the dough develops gluten, a stretchy network of proteins. The gluten traps the gas in small bubbles, so the dough expands instead of letting the gas escape.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Temperature affects how fast this happens. Yeast works best in warm conditions, around 25 to 30 degrees, and is killed at about 60 degrees, which is why rising stops once the loaf is in a hot oven.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Salt is added for flavour, but it also slows the yeast down, which gives the dough more time to develop a better taste. Too much salt, however, can stop the yeast working altogether.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Bakers who want a slower rise sometimes leave dough in the fridge overnight, which many people believe gives the finished loaf a deeper taste.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: the yeast feeds on sugars in the flour

explanation.en: “the yeast feeds on sugars in the flour” → sugars, letter D. H (water) is in the same sentence, but yeast does not feed on water.
explanation.kk: «the yeast feeds on sugars in the flour» → sugars, яғни D әрпі. H (water) да сөйлемде бар, бірақ ашытқы сумен қоректенбейді.
explanation.ru: «the yeast feeds on sugars in the flour» → sugars, буква D. H (water) тоже есть в предложении, но дрожжи питаются не водой.

explanation.en: “Kneading the dough develops gluten” → gluten, letter B. “Forms” paraphrases “develops”.
explanation.kk: «Kneading the dough develops gluten» → gluten, яғни B әрпі. «Forms» — «develops» дегеннің басқаша айтылымы.
explanation.ru: «Kneading the dough develops gluten» → gluten, буква B. «Forms» пересказывает «develops».

items.quote: Yeast works best in warm conditions

explanation.en: “Yeast works best in warm conditions” → warm, letter G. C (cold) is the opposite.
explanation.kk: «Yeast works best in warm conditions» → warm, яғни G әрпі. C (cold) — қарама-қарсы сөз.
explanation.ru: «Yeast works best in warm conditions» → warm, буква G. C (cold) — противоположность.

explanation.en: “Salt is added for flavour” and gives “a better taste” → flavour, letter E.
explanation.kk: «Salt is added for flavour», әрі «a better taste» береді → flavour, яғни E әрпі.
explanation.ru: «Salt is added for flavour» и даёт «a better taste» → flavour, буква E.

items.quote: it also slows the yeast down

explanation.en: “it also slows the yeast down” → the yeast works more slowly, letter A. F (quickly) is the opposite.
explanation.kk: «it also slows the yeast down» → баяу жұмыс істейді, slowly, яғни A әрпі. F (quickly) — керісінше.
explanation.ru: «it also slows the yeast down» → работать медленнее, slowly, буква A. F (quickly) — обратный смысл.
